chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhl, from Isa al-Farra', from Ibn Abi Ya'fur or from Zurarah (the doubt is from al-Hasan), from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj ten times, all of them secretly, passing by al-Ma'zimin, then he would descend and urinate.
ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet perform Hajj secretly and where did he relieve himself?
ai.summary: This hadith, found in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* under the chapter of expiation for unintentional errors, highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) practice of performing ten Hajjs, with these specific journeys conducted secretly (*mustasirran*) to avoid the crowds or political tensions of the time. The mention of al-Ma'zimin—a well-known spot near Mecca—serves as a practical reference for pilgrims regarding where to relieve themselves, illustrating the Prophet’s attention to both ritual purity and social modesty during his sacred journeys.
